thought.text: nginx.conf now routes to 39001/39002/39003, matching ports.json. Now start each frontend sequentially (only one build at a time to stay within memory):

reasoning_content: nginx.conf is rendered with the upstream ports 39001/39002/39003, and ports.json also matches. Next, I'll start the frontend sequentially (app, cms, boards) — each on its own saved (free) port. Since each server's port remains saved and free while the others are building, all of them will bind to the expected port.

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
setsid nohup bash -c 'exec just serve --apps=app < /dev/zero' > /tmp/app-final.log 2>&1 &
echo "app serve started pid $!"
